title: Funnel Set (4 Sizes: 122, 101, 76, 50mm) - Durable, Non-Toxic, Food-Grade Plastic funnels for Filling Bottles and containers. Ideal for Kitchen, Garage, or Labs. Perfect for Precise Pouring.
description:
About this item
Smart Kitchen Gadget: This environment-friendly kitchen funnel is made of premium food-grade plastic, which is durable & non-toxic. Our funnels for kitchen use filling bottles are temperate-resistant, long-lasting, and dishwasher safe to suit your needs in any situation.
Say Goodbye to Accidental Spills: The canning funnels for filling mason jars are the best solution for transferring any liquid. Each wide mouth funnel has a big narrow spout for easy pouring, which helps to fit in any bottle to ensure spill-free transfer easily. Keep the mess out of your home.
Simple & Space Saver: This collapsible funnel is designed to save space in your kitchen. The funnels for automotive use come with a hanging hole. You can hang them on your kitchen wall, or store them in your kitchen drawer for quick access.
Make Your Life Easier: Our funnel set is the perfect solution not only for transferring oil, spices, or car fuel but also for craft projects. Use the mini funnels for filling small bottles to sprinkle decorations on your art projects or for laboratory tasks at school.
4 Funnels in One: Our plastic funnel set comes in a pack of different sizes to fit various applications. The extra-large funnel measures 120mm, the large one is 100mm, the medium 75mm, and the small funnel is 50mm. Each size has its specific function.
